output.decision: Add the shaker cup to the third creatine subscription shipment. Do not add extra creatine: the observed cancellation reason is excess product, and the supplied evidence specifically cautions against gifting more of the subscribed item. Send a product- and third-order-specific billing reminder that clearly announces the included shaker cup without implying it will prevent cancellation.
next_steps: Include one shaker cup with every eligible third creatine subscription order, subject to inventory and shipping-fit checks.

Send the reminder before the third-order billing date: “Your third creatine subscription shipment is coming up. This order includes a complimentary shaker cup—no extra steps needed. Review or manage your shipment before [date].”
Use the actual charge date, management link, eligibility terms, and any applicable value/tax disclosures in the final message.
Track third-order cancellations, skips, support contacts, and gift fulfillment issues versus a comparable cohort.
Test a concise gift-led subject line against a standard billing reminder while keeping required billing information visible.
missing_inputs: Shaker cup unit cost, available inventory, dimensions, and fulfillment/shipping impact.
Reminder channel, send timing, required billing disclosures, and account-management URL.
Whether all third-order subscribers are eligible, including prior gift recipients and regional restrictions.
Baseline third-order cancel/skip rate and a measurement plan for the gift test.

evidence_used.supports: Avoiding additional creatine as a gift because it may add to subscriber inventory and contribute to delaying or cancelling future orders.
Communicating the subscription gift in subscriber messaging.
Tailoring the reminder to the subscribed product and order/rebill stage.
Using an upcoming gift as the focus of a billing reminder when the gift is included on order three.

assumptions: A shaker cup is complementary to creatine and does not create the same excess-inventory concern as extra creatine.
“Third subscription shipment” corresponds to the third order/rebill stage referenced in the supplied example.
The supplied library is unverified guidance; the proposed copy and test plan are operational recommendations, not demonstrated performance claims.

input.question: What gift should we add to the third subscription shipment, and what should the reminder say?

library.title: Avoid giving the subscribed product as a free gift

claim.text: The speaker warns that giving more of the same product as a free gift can leave a subscriber with excess inventory and lead them to delay or cancel a future order.
claim.quote: then you give me a free gift of more creatine, then I'm going to have a lot of creatine and I'm probably going to delay or cancel my next order with you because I have too much.

action.text: Do not give more of the same subscribed product as the free gift.
action.quote: I don't want you to give more of the same product as a part of the free gift.

args.text: A free gift is being selected.
args.quote: as a part of the free gift.

unknowns: The source does not specify which complementary gifts are appropriate.

library.title: Communicate subscription gifts to subscribers

claim.text: The speaker says gifts have no point if they are not communicated.
claim.quote: there is no point of having these gifts if you don't communicate this.

action.text: Communicate subscription gifts in subscriber messaging.
action.quote: that's going to be one of the key things that we want to talk about in our subscriber messaging.

unknowns: The source does not define the required frequency or exact content of gift communications.

library.title: Customize billing reminders by subscribed product and rebuild stage

claim.text: The speaker recommends tailoring billing reminders to the subscribed product and what the speaker calls the customer's rebuild stage.
claim.quote: customize all of your billing reminders based on the product the person is subscribed to and based on what rebuild they're on.

action.text: Customize billing reminders by subscribed product and rebuild stage.
action.quote: customize all of your billing reminders based on the product the person is subscribed to and based on what rebuild they're on.

unknowns: The term rebuild is not defined and may refer to rebill or order number.
The source does not specify messaging for each product or rebuild stage.

library.title: Gift-focused billing reminder for an upcoming free gift

claim.text: As an example, the speaker says that when a customer will receive a free gift in the next bill, the billing reminder can focus on that upcoming gift.
claim.quote: then we can completely change our billing reminder to be focused on that cuz nobody's going to want to cancel if they're getting this free thing upcoming.

args.text: The customer is known to receive a free gift in the next bill, such as on order three.
args.quote: if you know that a customer is going to get a free gift in the next bill, like if on order three you give a free gift

unknowns: This is presented as a simple example rather than a measured or universal outcome.
The source does not establish that all customers receiving an upcoming gift will be less likely to cancel.
